Conceded: filed statements show an ROE of 20.5% [E13] and a multi-year median ROE of 33% over three years [E19]. However, the bull ignores that the company pays a dividend yield of exactly 0.00% [E4], meaning investors realize zero cash return on their capital despite these reported returns. Furthermore, third-party data places the company's Return on Assets (ROA) at a stark 0% against a sector benchmark of 5.79% [E8], exposing a severe underlying asset productivity weakness that filed return metrics gloss over. While the bull leans heavily on historical medians [E18, E19], the most recent comparative data provider metric shows the company's trailing ROE has compressed to 13.69%, lagging the sector benchmark of 14.39% [E9]. Finally, attempting to dismiss this peer comparison as a third-party discrepancy fails because the same data sources are used across the board to evaluate if the ₹ 226 Cr market capitalization is justified by operational efficiency [E3, E8, E9].
